dimensions.assessment: Affects residents, visitors, and federal and local law enforcement personnel operating within the District of Columbia.
dimensions.evidence: maintain the cleanliness of Federal and District of Columbia facilities, monuments, land, public spaces, sidewalks, parks, highways, roads, transit systems

dimensions.assessment: Coordinates federal and local resources for facility maintenance, monument restoration, immigration enforcement policies, and crime reduction efforts in the District of Columbia.
dimensions.evidence: developing and encouraging the implementation of polices that will direct the maximum enforcement of Federal immigration law within the District of Columbia

dimensions.assessment: Directs federal agencies and officials to coordinate activities and resources in the District of Columbia, but specifies no direct funding authorization.
Establishes a new federal beautification program and a multi-agency executive commission with wide-ranging mandates covering federal lands, law enforcement, and local policies.
dimensions.evidence: establish a program to beautify the District of Columbia and to establish the District of Columbia Safe and Beautiful Commission

dimensions.assessment: Sets a fixed temporary duration, terminating both the program and the commission on January 2, 2029.
dimensions.evidence: This section, and the Program established by this section, shall terminate on January 2, 2029.

missing_information: Specific appropriations or budget allocations required to carry out the program and commission activities.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill establishes a federal beautification program and an executive commission for the District of Columbia to coordinate local and federal actions on immigration enforcement, public safety, and infrastructure.
